title: Kasdan Co. — Food & Drink Photography
summary: Seasonal menu photography for our café — shot outside, styled with a sense of humour and made for the feed.
overview: Menu photos don't have to be shot on a white table. For Kasdan Co., our café in Sault Ste. Marie, we take the drinks and donuts outside — into the autumn woods, onto an iron fence, into a flowering garden — and give each seasonal launch an image people stop and share.

cover.alt: A person in a white bedsheet ghost costume and sunglasses peeks out from behind a tree in autumn woods, holding an iced latte decorated with little ghost faces

idea.heading: The approach
body: Each menu has a story, and the photo should tell it before anyone reads the caption. The Halloween iced latte has ghost faces on the cup, so it's held by ghosts. The fall donuts line up on a fence under a maple in full colour.
We plan the styling, location and light together, then shoot a set that works for menu boards, Instagram posts, Reels covers and paid ads.

execution.heading: What you get
body: Concept and styling, an on-location shoot, colour-graded selects in square, portrait and vertical crops, and short behind-the-scenes clips for Stories and TikTok.
